WITH product_revenue AS (
    SELECT
        ProductKey,
        sum(SalesAmount) AS revenue
    FROM retail.FactOnlineSales
    WHERE toYear(DateKey) = 2009
    GROUP BY ProductKey
),
ranked_products AS (
    SELECT
        ProductKey,
        revenue,
        sum(revenue) OVER (ORDER BY revenue DESC, ProductKey ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) / nullif(sum(revenue) OVER (), 0) AS cumulative_revenue_pct
    FROM product_revenue
)
SELECT
    abc_class,
    count() AS product_count
FROM (
    SELECT
        ProductKey,
        CASE
            WHEN cumulative_revenue_pct <= 0.80 THEN 'A'
            WHEN cumulative_revenue_pct <= 0.95 THEN 'B'
            ELSE 'C'
        END AS abc_class
    FROM ranked_products
)
GROUP BY abc_class
ORDER BY abc_class
